AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of soil? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of soil.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of soil.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of soil.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Land? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Land.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Land.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Land.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Land Preparation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Land Preparation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Land Preparation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Land Preparation.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Weed control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Weed control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Weed control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Weed control.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crop? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crop.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crop.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crop.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crop.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Agricultural Land and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of soil and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Land Preparation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Field Management Practices and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

2. C — Ice melting to water

3. C — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

4. D — newton (N)

5. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.

6. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.

7. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.

8. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.

9. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock.

10. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crop.

11. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.

12. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Land Preparation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
